# Jeremiah 2 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 2:1 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-came [the]-word-of YHWH to-me, saying: |
| LOGOS | The word of the LORD came to me, saying, |
| PNEUMA | The LORD spoke to me: |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 2:15 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Against-him young-lions roar; they-give their-voice, and-they-make his-land a-desolation; his-cities are-burned without inhabitant. |
| LOGOS | The young lions have roared against him; they have roared loudly. They have made his land a waste; his cities are in ruins, without inhabitant. |
| PNEUMA | Lions have roared over him and devastated his land. His cities lie in smoking ruins, completely empty. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

| Translator | Rendering |

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | A-wild-donkey accustomed-to [the]-wilderness, in-[the]-desire-of her-soul she-snuffs [the]-wind; her-heat — who can-turn-her-back? All seeking-her will-not-weary-themselves; in-her-month they-will-find-her. |
| LOGOS | A wild donkey used to the wilderness, in her heat sniffing the wind! Who can restrain her lust? None who seek her need weary themselves; in her month they will find her. |
